image_description: Two cloth diapers (reusable nappies) placed side-by-side on a textured, brownish-yellow patterned surface (likely a rug or blanket). The left diaper is light blue/teal with white polka dots and visible snap fasteners. The right diaper is a slightly darker blue with similar white snap fasteners and elasticized leg openings. Both show the characteristic bulky, padded shape of infant diapers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular when flat, with elasticized leg openings and waistband.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diapers are not flat but folded/worn-shape, yet they clearly exhibit elasticized leg openings (gathered edges) and a defined waistband area. The overall silhouette matches the expected bulky rectangular form when accounting for the 3D padding.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thickness is notably padded and bulky when uncompressed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both diapers show significant volume and puffiness, indicating a thick absorbent core. The shadows and highlights confirm substantial thickness consistent with padded infant garments.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Folded form shows layered construction with absorbent core between layers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diapers appear to be closed/prepped rather than open-folded. The internal layered construction of the absorbent core is not visually exposed; only the outer shell and fastening points are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fastening system uses adhesive tabs (hook-and-loop or sticky) on side panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: White circular snap fasteners are clearly visible on the front panels of both diapers. While these are snaps rather than adhesive tabs, they serve the identical functional role of a fastening system on side/front panels. This is a valid variation for reusable cloth diapers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elastic creates gathered ruffles at leg cuffs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct gathered, ruffled edges are visible along the leg openings of both diapers, particularly noticeable on the right diaper's inner thigh area. This confirms the presence of elastic casing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Size indicators and wetness strip may be visible.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No size tags, labels, or color-changing wetness indicator strips are visible on the exterior surfaces of either diaper. This is an optional feature and its absence does not negate class identity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Outer surface is smooth plastic or fabric-like material in white or printed patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The outer surface appears to be a soft fabric (likely cotton or PUL - polyurethane laminate) with printed patterns (polka dots on the left, solid/micro-pattern on the right). The texture is consistent with cloth diaper materials.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Inner surface is soft non-woven fabric.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The inner lining (which would touch the baby's skin) is not exposed in this view. Only the exterior and edge bindings are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Absorbent padded core with waterproof outer layer.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bulkiness implies an absorbent core. The slight sheen on the fabric suggests a waterproof or water-resistant outer layer (common in modern cloth diapers). While we cannot chemically verify waterproofing, the visual cues align with this structural expectation.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background texture (rug/blanket) has a slightly repetitive, 'smudged' appearance typical of AI-generated patterns. Some fibers blend into each other without clear individual definition, suggesting minor texture synthesis issues.

The white strap/tab extending from the right side of the left diaper appears to merge ambiguously with the background and lacks a clear termination point or functional connection. It looks partially melted or ill-defined compared to the crisp snaps on the front.

The white snap buttons on the right diaper have slightly inconsistent elliptical shapes that don't perfectly align with a single coherent perspective plane. They appear slightly warped rather than uniformly oval.
